summary: Phase4 memory is intentionally local and short-lived: provider status remains bridge-owned, while loaded model lists live only in the ProviderSettings component for the modal lifetime.

memory_surfaces.purpose: Provider registry and model catalog source of truth
memory_surfaces.source_of_truth: llm_bridge registry entries and models.dev cache

memory_surfaces.purpose: Lazy-loaded model lists keyed by provider id
memory_surfaces.invalidated_by: Closing the modal or recreating the component

memory_surfaces.purpose: Provider credentials and active model selection

retention: No browser persistent cache is introduced. Model lists, errors, and chip expansion are discarded when ProviderSettings unmounts.
serialization: Provider status and per-provider models remain JSON API payloads. The in-memory Map/Set state is not serialized.
privacy: Model catalog calls do not include API keys
Provider upsert responses continue to avoid echoing apiKey values
No localStorage model catalog cache is added
reconciliation: Each modal open starts from fresh compact provider status. Each provider model list reconciles from /providers/{id}/models on first need.
observability: model_count allows the UI/tests to know a compact provider still has models
Field warnings expose lazy model fetch failures
Automated tests validate compact and full provider states
